map.昵称生成器是一款IT 开发领域的在线工具。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，: Nickname Generator is an online tool for IT development. It runs entirely on the front end, so your code never leaves the browser.
map.组合 = 形容词词库 × 名词词库 × 可选数字后缀: Combination = adjective word list × noun word list × optional numeric suffix
map.本工具从形容词与名词词库做笛卡尔积组合，并按风格（可爱、酷炫、古风、游戏等）筛选: This tool takes the Cartesian product of an adjective list and a noun list, filters the lists by style (cute, cool, classical, gaming and so on), and can append a numeric suffix to reduce the chance of duplicates. Generation happens entirely in the browser and the word lists are built in, so it cannot check whether a nickname is already taken on your target platform — after generating a batch you still need to try registering it. If you need reproducible results you can fix the random seed, in which case the same input sequence yields the same set of nicknames.

map.生成的昵称会被占用吗？: Will a generated nickname already be taken?
map.大概率会。本工具只在本地按词库组合，无法查询各平台是否已注册——越是常用词组合，: Quite possibly. This tool only combines word lists locally and cannot query whether a nickname is registered on any platform — the more common the word combination, the higher the chance it is taken. Generate several candidates at once and rank them by how unusual they are: adding a personal touch or going for a longer combination noticeably improves your odds.
